summary: On the main deck, everyone is strapped into their chairs and Tank is at the operator's station. Tank addresses the crew as if making an airline announcement, telling them to observe that the no smoking and fasten seat belt signs have been turned on and to sit back and enjoy their flight. He strikes the enter key, and the camera rushes clockwise over the chairs as each body reacts.

what_changes.before: Addressing the crew with an airline-style announcement
what_changes.after: Striking the enter key to initiate something as bodies react
